title: Cable Glute Kickback
summary: A standing kickback from a low cable with an ankle strap, isolating one glute.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for glutes (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.3 for hamstrings (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly hamstrings total.

setup.text: Attach an ankle strap and face the stack, holding on for support.
Kick your leg back by squeezing your glute.

form_cues.cue: Lean forward a little so you get a longer range.

mistakes.text: Swinging the arm to finish reps.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
